column3: 'I need help now' and free text (incl. 'Something else' and Dump) are watched; risk → Help/SOS (SF-1). Help line under Life right now → SF-3. Urgent body signs → SF-4.
First time on Home: 'Set things up your way' settings sheet before the first check-in (ST-1). Then Home offers: Quick check-in · Full check-in · I need help with… No browse mode (SU-1).
Energy (4) × Mood (4), nothing pre-selected. Result shown INSTANTLY on the same screen: state name, icon, one-line meaning, baseline colour.
Three picture taps → suggested state the user confirms (NS-1).

Up to TWO of 20 emotions (10 free on screen + Something else; More = Prime). Each chosen emotion shows a slider only. Result inline: colour after FE-1/FE-2 (and BS-1 later), one plain sentence, optional 'Breathe first?' chip in Amber/Red.
One screen, two tabs: Body (Tab 3) with the urgent signs row, and Senses. BS-1 may lower the colour (one step in total with feelings, CAP-1); senses never do. Urgent sign → SF-4 first.

Asked fresh (CTX-0): place; 'Can you step away?' (Yes / No); help or devices with me. Never changes the colour (CX-R, DV-R); chooses discreet or open tools and the route. Result: 'Got it — we'll pick things that work {place words}.'
Tab 2 triggers + 6c gates (RF/MD) + Life right now ordering (ME-4).
